task: real-image aligned yellow-cup approach and subsequent grasp, not additional air motion

required_files.model/policy.ckpt: new task-specific checkpoint; include SHA256 and architecture/task scope
required_files.model/training_config.json: full model, data, image preprocessing and execution settings
required_files.model/input_action_schema.json: every state/action component ordered with units, camera keys, coordinate frame, gripper semantics and initialization
required_files.scene/alignment.json: applied initial state, camera pose/intrinsics/orientation, source/destination/table/TCP transforms and explicit uncertainty handling
required_files.scene/real_vs_rendered.png: same recorded start and camera; show cup/card/robot overlays
required_files.evaluation/summary.json: same checkpoint hash, split/scenario seeds, nominal/noisy/corrective results, all failures, latency settings, teacher_free=true
required_files.evaluation/rollouts: states, policy predictions, sent targets, object/TCP poses, collisions/clearance and outcome evidence
required_files.preview/approach.json: complete predicted/replayed noncontact segment with arm/gripper targets, start checks, geometric scope and stop conditions
required_files.executor/: complete runtime + dependencies/config + default no-motion preview + explicit execute entry; preserve current ROS control_gate and freshness fixes
required_files.tests/: meaningful offline compatibility and execution-contract checks with actual results

acceptance_notes: 300-step air trial is control-chain evidence only; it does not validate contact geometry or grasp success.
Do not export a checkpoint alone or claim re-labelling deployment flags creates a valid grasp executor.
First physical stage stops at a geometrically validated noncontact pregrasp pose; grasp closure and transport require their own observed acceptance.
If evaluation fails, return reports and the failed status; do not label the package ready for physical grasp.
Use the current paired state in simulation_request.json, not the prior air-model start or old v9 posture.
Unverified physical TCP/table/extrinsics must remain explicit. A visual estimate or low reprojection residual is not an independent coordinate survey.
